tools.goalsIntro: Pick what this Pokémon must do; the damage calc finds the fewest HP, Def, SpD and Spe EVs (and the best nature) that do it. “Survive” means every damage roll from full HP, no critical hit. Attackers use their most common set ({source}).

evGoals.tooStrong: Even with 252 HP / 252 {stat, select, def {Def} other {SpD}} EVs, {attacker}'s {move} does up to {pct}% to {name}.
evGoals.noLimit: Gen 1 and 2 have no EV limit: max every stat.
evGoals.notAll: Impossible: each goal can be met on its own, but not all of them within 510 EVs.
